_meta.source: Curated from public INCI knowledge; informational only — not medical/regulatory advice. Plain-language descriptions for the KoreaPlus K-beauty ingredient decoder.
_meta.note: Function & risk flags are general guidance. Patch-test new products. Consult a dermatologist for medical concerns.

glycerin.name: Glycerin (Glycerol)
glycerin.desc: A classic water-binding humectant that draws moisture into the skin and helps keep it soft and hydrated.

sodium hyaluronate.name: Sodium Hyaluronate
sodium hyaluronate.desc: The salt form of hyaluronic acid that holds water in the skin to support plump, hydrated-looking skin.

hyaluronic acid.name: Hyaluronic Acid
hyaluronic acid.desc: A large moisture-binding molecule that helps the skin's surface feel hydrated, smooth, and supple.

hydrolyzed hyaluronic acid.name: Hydrolyzed Hyaluronic Acid
hydrolyzed hyaluronic acid.desc: A smaller, broken-down form of hyaluronic acid that penetrates more easily to support deeper-feeling hydration.

sodium hyaluronate crosspolymer.name: Sodium Hyaluronate Crosspolymer
sodium hyaluronate crosspolymer.desc: A modified hyaluronic acid that forms a light film to help hold moisture at the skin surface longer.

sodium acetylated hyaluronate.name: Acetylated Sodium Hyaluronate (Super HA)
sodium acetylated hyaluronate.desc: A modified hyaluronic acid that clings to skin well to help maintain lasting surface hydration.

sodium pca.name: Sodium PCA
sodium pca.desc: A natural moisturizing factor found in skin that attracts and holds water to support hydration.

betaine.name: Betaine
betaine.desc: A gentle sugar-beet-derived humectant that helps hydrate and soften skin while supporting a smooth feel.

panthenol.name: Panthenol (Pro-Vitamin B5)
panthenol.desc: A pro-vitamin B5 ingredient that helps hydrate and soothe skin while supporting a soft, comfortable feel.

urea.name: Urea
urea.desc: A natural moisturizing factor that hydrates and, at higher concentrations, helps soften the look and feel of rough, dry, flaky skin.

propylene glycol.name: Propylene Glycol
propylene glycol.desc: A lightweight humectant and solvent that helps hydrate skin and carry other ingredients evenly.

butylene glycol.name: Butylene Glycol
butylene glycol.desc: A light humectant and solvent that helps draw in moisture and gives products a smooth, fast-absorbing feel.

pentylene glycol.name: Pentylene Glycol
pentylene glycol.desc: A multitasking humectant that hydrates skin and helps keep the formula fresh and well-blended.

1,2-hexanediol.name: 1,2-Hexanediol
1,2-hexanediol.desc: A lightweight ingredient that supports skin hydration while helping keep the formula stable and fresh.

caprylyl glycol.name: Caprylyl Glycol
caprylyl glycol.desc: A skin-conditioning humectant that helps soften skin and supports the freshness of the formula.

trehalose.name: Trehalose
trehalose.desc: A protective sugar that holds water and helps skin stay hydrated and comfortable under dryness or stress.

honey.name: Honey (Mel)
honey.desc: A natural sugar-rich humectant that attracts moisture and helps soften and soothe the skin.

sodium lactate.name: Sodium Lactate
sodium lactate.desc: A natural moisturizing factor and salt of lactic acid that helps bind water and keep skin hydrated.

lactic acid.name: Lactic Acid
lactic acid.desc: An AHA that at low levels hydrates and at higher levels helps gently smooth and renew the skin surface.

glycereth-26.name: Glycereth-26
glycereth-26.desc: A glycerin-based humectant that draws in moisture to help keep skin soft and hydrated.

saccharide isomerate.name: Saccharide Isomerate (Pentavitin)
saccharide isomerate.desc: A plant-sugar complex that binds to skin to support long-lasting, deep-feeling hydration.

aloe barbadensis leaf juice.name: Aloe Vera Leaf Juice
aloe barbadensis leaf juice.desc: A water-rich plant juice that helps hydrate and soothe skin while supporting a calm, comfortable feel.

sorbitol.name: Sorbitol
sorbitol.desc: A sugar-derived humectant that attracts moisture and helps give skin a soft, smooth feel.

glycerol glucoside.name: Glycerol Glucoside (Glycoin)
glycerol glucoside.desc: A desert-plant-inspired humectant that helps skin retain water and stay resilient against dryness.

hydroxyethyl urea.name: Hydroxyethyl Urea
hydroxyethyl urea.desc: A gentle, non-sticky humectant that helps skin hold onto water for a hydrated, supple feel.

fructose.name: Fructose
fructose.desc: A natural fruit sugar that attracts moisture and helps support skin hydration.

glucose.name: Glucose
glucose.desc: A simple sugar that binds water to help keep skin hydrated and soft.

inositol.name: Inositol
inositol.desc: A sugar-like conditioning agent that helps hydrate and support a smooth, comfortable skin feel.

allantoin.name: Allantoin
allantoin.desc: A gentle conditioning ingredient that helps soothe and soften skin while supporting a comfortable feel.

pca.name: PCA (Pyrrolidone Carboxylic Acid)
pca.desc: A natural moisturizing factor that helps skin attract and hold water for better hydration.

hydrolyzed sodium hyaluronate.name: Hydrolyzed Sodium Hyaluronate
hydrolyzed sodium hyaluronate.desc: A small fragment of hyaluronic acid salt that absorbs easily to support deeper-feeling hydration.

sodium hyaluronate crosspolymer-2.name: Sodium Hyaluronate Crosspolymer-2
sodium hyaluronate crosspolymer-2.desc: A cross-linked hyaluronic acid that forms a moisture-holding network on the skin surface.

maltodextrin.name: Maltodextrin
maltodextrin.desc: A plant-sugar ingredient that helps bind moisture and gives products a smooth, conditioning feel.

glycogen.name: Glycogen
glycogen.desc: A complex sugar that helps skin hold water and supports a hydrated, refreshed feel.

beta-glucan.name: Beta-Glucan
beta-glucan.desc: An oat- or yeast-derived sugar that helps hydrate and soothe skin while supporting a comfortable feel.

polyglutamic acid.name: Polyglutamic Acid
polyglutamic acid.desc: A fermented amino-acid polymer that holds water at the skin surface to help boost lasting hydration.

xylitol.name: Xylitol
xylitol.desc: A plant-sugar humectant that attracts moisture and helps support the skin's hydration balance.

snail secretion filtrate.name: Snail Secretion Filtrate (Snail Mucin)
snail secretion filtrate.desc: A moisture-rich snail-derived filtrate that helps hydrate and soothe skin for a soft, supple feel.

centella asiatica extract.name: Centella Asiatica Extract (Cica)
centella asiatica extract.desc: A calming plant extract that helps soothe and hydrate skin while supporting a comfortable, balanced feel.

squalane.name: Squalane
squalane.desc: A lightweight oil that mimics skin's own lipids to soften and lock in moisture without feeling greasy.

caprylic/capric triglyceride.name: Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride
caprylic/capric triglyceride.desc: A silky coconut-derived oil that smooths and conditions skin while helping other ingredients spread evenly.

dimethicone.name: Dimethicone
dimethicone.desc: A breathable silicone that forms a smooth protective layer to help skin hold onto moisture.

cyclopentasiloxane.name: Cyclopentasiloxane (D5)
cyclopentasiloxane.desc: A light silicone that gives a silky slip and then evaporates, leaving skin feeling soft and smooth.

cyclomethicone.name: Cyclomethicone
cyclomethicone.desc: A fast-spreading silicone blend that adds a smooth, weightless feel and helps products glide on.

dimethicone/vinyl dimethicone crosspolym.name: Dimethicone Crosspolymer
dimethicone/vinyl dimethicone crosspolym.desc: A bouncy silicone gel that blurs the look of pores and gives a soft, velvety finish.

butyrospermum parkii (shea) butter.name: Shea Butter
butyrospermum parkii (shea) butter.desc: A rich plant butter that deeply softens and supports the skin barrier, ideal for dry, tight skin.

simmondsia chinensis (jojoba) seed oil.name: Jojoba Oil
simmondsia chinensis (jojoba) seed oil.desc: A wax-like oil very close to skin's natural sebum that conditions and balances without heaviness.

helianthus annuus (sunflower) seed oil.name: Sunflower Oil
helianthus annuus (sunflower) seed oil.desc: A light, antioxidant-rich oil that softens skin and helps reinforce its moisture barrier.

petrolatum.name: Petrolatum
petrolatum.desc: A classic protective ointment that seals in water to help very dry or chapped skin stay hydrated.

paraffinum liquidum.name: Mineral Oil
paraffinum liquidum.desc: A gentle, non-irritating oil that forms a barrier to slow water loss and keep skin soft.

cera alba.name: Beeswax
cera alba.desc: A natural wax that thickens products and forms a protective layer to help skin retain moisture.

lanolin.name: Lanolin
lanolin.desc: A wool-derived wax that closely mimics skin lipids to soften and protect very dry areas.

ceramide np.name: Ceramide NP
ceramide np.desc: A skin-identical lipid that helps rebuild and strengthen the moisture barrier for smoother, calmer skin.

ceramide ap.name: Ceramide AP
ceramide ap.desc: A barrier-supporting ceramide that helps skin stay resilient and hold onto hydration.

ceramide eop.name: Ceramide EOP
ceramide eop.desc: A structural ceramide that helps seal the barrier and support long-lasting moisture.

cholesterol.name: Cholesterol
cholesterol.desc: A natural barrier lipid that works with ceramides to keep skin supple and well-protected.

cetyl alcohol.name: Cetyl Alcohol
cetyl alcohol.desc: A nourishing fatty alcohol that softens skin and gives creams a smooth, stable texture.

cetearyl alcohol.name: Cetearyl Alcohol
cetearyl alcohol.desc: A creamy fatty alcohol that conditions skin and keeps oil and water blended in a lotion.

stearyl alcohol.name: Stearyl Alcohol
stearyl alcohol.desc: A softening fatty alcohol that thickens formulas and helps leave skin feeling smooth.

stearic acid.name: Stearic Acid
stearic acid.desc: A fatty acid that helps emulsify creams and leaves a soft, conditioned feel on skin.

glyceryl stearate.name: Glyceryl Stearate
glyceryl stearate.desc: A gentle emulsifier that blends oil and water while softening and smoothing the skin.

glyceryl stearate se.name: Glyceryl Stearate SE
glyceryl stearate se.desc: A self-emulsifying version of glyceryl stearate that creates rich, stable creams and conditions skin.

isopropyl myristate.name: Isopropyl Myristate
isopropyl myristate.desc: A fast-absorbing ester that adds slip and a non-greasy softness to lotions and serums.

isopropyl palmitate.name: Isopropyl Palmitate
isopropyl palmitate.desc: A smooth ester that conditions skin and gives products a light, easily spreadable feel.

cocos nucifera (coconut) oil.name: Coconut Oil
cocos nucifera (coconut) oil.desc: A rich tropical oil that deeply softens skin and helps slow moisture loss.

prunus amygdalus dulcis (sweet almond) o.name: Sweet Almond Oil
prunus amygdalus dulcis (sweet almond) o.desc: A mild, nourishing oil that softens and soothes skin while supporting its moisture barrier.

argania spinosa kernel oil.name: Argan Oil
argania spinosa kernel oil.desc: A vitamin-rich oil that conditions and softens skin while helping it feel supple.

rosa canina fruit oil.name: Rosehip Oil
rosa canina fruit oil.desc: A fatty-acid-rich oil that softens skin and helps support a smooth, even-looking complexion.

olea europaea (olive) fruit oil.name: Olive Oil
olea europaea (olive) fruit oil.desc: A rich, antioxidant-containing oil that softens and helps protect dry skin from moisture loss.

persea gratissima (avocado) oil.name: Avocado Oil
persea gratissima (avocado) oil.desc: A deeply nourishing oil that softens skin and helps replenish a dry, depleted barrier.

tocopherol.name: Vitamin E
tocopherol.desc: A skin-loving antioxidant that helps protect oils from going off while softening and conditioning skin.

tocopheryl acetate.name: Vitamin E Acetate
tocopheryl acetate.desc: A stable form of vitamin E that conditions skin and helps defend against everyday environmental stress.

hydrogenated polyisobutene.name: Hydrogenated Polyisobutene
hydrogenated polyisobutene.desc: A clean-feeling synthetic oil that adds slip and helps lock in moisture without a greasy finish.

c13-15 alkane.name: Coconut Alkane / C13-15 Alkane
c13-15 alkane.desc: A light, silicone-free emollient that gives a silky slip and softens skin.

theobroma cacao (cocoa) seed butter.name: Cocoa Butter
theobroma cacao (cocoa) seed butter.desc: A rich plant butter that forms a softening, protective layer to comfort very dry skin.

phytosphingosine.name: Phytosphingosine
phytosphingosine.desc: A barrier lipid that helps support ceramide production and keeps skin feeling calm and balanced.

behenyl alcohol.name: Behenyl Alcohol
behenyl alcohol.desc: A waxy fatty alcohol that thickens creams and leaves skin feeling soft and smooth.

glycolic acid.name: Glycolic Acid
glycolic acid.desc: A small alpha-hydroxy acid that helps loosen dead surface cells so skin looks smoother and brighter.

salicylic acid.name: Salicylic Acid
salicylic acid.desc: An oil-soluble acid that helps clear inside pores and supports a smoother, clearer complexion.

mandelic acid.name: Mandelic Acid
mandelic acid.desc: A large, slow-acting alpha-hydroxy acid that helps gently exfoliate and is often kinder to sensitive skin.

gluconolactone.name: Gluconolactone
gluconolactone.desc: A polyhydroxy acid that helps gently smooth skin while also drawing in moisture.

lactobionic acid.name: Lactobionic Acid
lactobionic acid.desc: A large polyhydroxy acid that helps gently exfoliate and supports the skin's moisture barrier.

malic acid.name: Malic Acid
malic acid.desc: A fruit-derived alpha-hydroxy acid that helps loosen dead cells for a smoother surface.

tartaric acid.name: Tartaric Acid
tartaric acid.desc: A grape-derived acid that helps with gentle exfoliation and supports a balanced product pH.

citric acid.name: Citric Acid
citric acid.desc: A common acid that helps lightly exfoliate and is widely used to set a product's pH.

phytic acid.name: Phytic Acid
phytic acid.desc: A grain-derived acid that helps gently exfoliate and supports a more even-looking tone.

azelaic acid.name: Azelaic Acid
azelaic acid.desc: A grain-derived acid that helps smooth texture and supports a clearer, more even complexion.

ascorbic acid.name: Vitamin C (L-Ascorbic Acid)
ascorbic acid.desc: The pure form of vitamin C that helps brighten skin and supports defense against daily environmental stress.

sodium ascorbyl phosphate.name: Sodium Ascorbyl Phosphate
sodium ascorbyl phosphate.desc: A stable, water-friendly vitamin C that helps brighten and supports a more even-looking tone.

magnesium ascorbyl phosphate.name: Magnesium Ascorbyl Phosphate
magnesium ascorbyl phosphate.desc: A gentle, stable vitamin C form that helps brighten skin and supports hydration.

ascorbyl glucoside.name: Ascorbyl Glucoside
ascorbyl glucoside.desc: A stable vitamin C derivative that helps brighten and supports a smoother, more radiant look.

3-o-ethyl ascorbic acid.name: Ethyl Ascorbic Acid
3-o-ethyl ascorbic acid.desc: A stable, fast-absorbing vitamin C that helps brighten and supports an even-looking complexion.

tetrahexyldecyl ascorbate.name: Tetrahexyldecyl Ascorbate
tetrahexyldecyl ascorbate.desc: An oil-soluble vitamin C that helps brighten and supports skin against environmental stress.

ascorbyl tetraisopalmitate.name: Ascorbyl Tetraisopalmitate
ascorbyl tetraisopalmitate.desc: An oil-loving, stable vitamin C that helps brighten and supports a radiant appearance.

ascorbyl palmitate.name: Ascorbyl Palmitate
ascorbyl palmitate.desc: A fat-soluble vitamin C derivative that helps support antioxidant defense in skincare.

retinol.name: Retinol
retinol.desc: A vitamin A active that helps smooth texture and supports the look of firmer, more even skin.

retinal.name: Retinaldehyde
retinal.desc: A potent vitamin A form that helps refine texture and supports a smoother, more even appearance.

retinyl palmitate.name: Retinyl Palmitate
retinyl palmitate.desc: A gentle vitamin A ester that helps support smoother-looking, conditioned skin.

retinyl retinoate.name: Retinyl Retinoate
retinyl retinoate.desc: A hybrid vitamin A derivative that helps smooth and supports a refined, even-looking surface.

hydroxypinacolone retinoate.name: Hydroxypinacolone Retinoate (Granactive Retinoid)
hydroxypinacolone retinoate.desc: A next-generation vitamin A active that helps smooth texture with typically less irritation.

bakuchiol.name: Bakuchiol
bakuchiol.desc: A plant-derived ingredient that helps support smoother, firmer-looking skin as a gentle retinol alternative.

niacinamide.name: Niacinamide (Vitamin B3)
niacinamide.desc: A versatile vitamin B3 that helps brighten, support the moisture barrier, and minimize the look of pores.

adenosine.name: Adenosine
adenosine.desc: A skin-identical compound that helps support a smoother, firmer-looking complexion.

tranexamic acid.name: Tranexamic Acid
tranexamic acid.desc: An ingredient included to support a more even-looking tone and reduce the look of dark spots.

alpha-arbutin.name: Alpha-Arbutin
alpha-arbutin.desc: A gentle brightening ingredient that helps reduce the look of dark spots for a more even tone.

arbutin.name: Arbutin
arbutin.desc: A plant-derived brightener that helps support a more even, radiant-looking complexion.

kojic acid.name: Kojic Acid
kojic acid.desc: A fungus-derived ingredient that helps support a brighter, more even-looking tone.

ferulic acid.name: Ferulic Acid
ferulic acid.desc: A plant antioxidant that helps support and stabilize vitamins C and E for better day-to-day antioxidant defense.

resveratrol.name: Resveratrol
resveratrol.desc: A grape-derived antioxidant that helps support skin against daily environmental stress.

glutathione.name: Glutathione
glutathione.desc: An antioxidant included to support the look of a brighter, more even-looking complexion (topical brightening evidence is limited).

centella asiatica leaf water.name: Centella Asiatica Leaf Water
centella asiatica leaf water.desc: A water-light cica extract that hydrates and helps calm the look of redness on sensitive skin.

madecassoside.name: Madecassoside
madecassoside.desc: A purified centella compound that helps soothe and comfort skin that looks irritated or stressed.

asiaticoside.name: Asiaticoside
asiaticoside.desc: A centella-derived active that supports a calm, comfortable feel and helps the skin look smoother.

madecassic acid.name: Madecassic Acid
madecassic acid.desc: One of centella's key actives that helps soothe and support skin looking tired or sensitized.

asiatic acid.name: Asiatic Acid
asiatic acid.desc: A centella compound that helps support a smooth, comforted look in stressed-looking skin.

propolis extract.name: Propolis Extract
propolis extract.desc: A bee-derived extract that helps comfort and condition skin while giving it a healthy-looking glow.

bee venom.name: Bee Venom
bee venom.desc: A bee-derived ingredient used to give skin a temporarily firmer, smoother-looking appearance; can irritate sensitive skin.

royal jelly extract.name: Royal Jelly Extract
royal jelly extract.desc: A nutrient-rich bee secretion that helps nourish and condition skin for a supple feel.

artemisia capillaris extract.name: Mugwort (Artemisia) Extract
artemisia capillaris extract.desc: A calming herbal extract that helps soothe sensitive-looking skin and supports a comfortable feel.

artemisia princeps leaf extract.name: Korean Mugwort Leaf Extract
artemisia princeps leaf extract.desc: A mugwort extract that helps calm and condition skin that looks reactive or irritated.

houttuynia cordata extract.name: Heartleaf (Houttuynia) Extract
houttuynia cordata extract.desc: A gentle herbal extract that helps soothe and refresh skin prone to looking red or congested.

oryza sativa extract.name: Rice (Oryza Sativa) Extract
oryza sativa extract.desc: A rice-derived extract that helps brighten the look of dull skin and supports a smooth tone.

oryza sativa (rice) ferment filtrate.name: Rice Ferment Filtrate
oryza sativa (rice) ferment filtrate.desc: A fermented rice liquid that hydrates and helps skin look more even and luminous.

oryza sativa bran water.name: Rice Bran Water
oryza sativa bran water.desc: A water-light rice ingredient that hydrates and helps soften the look of the skin.

panax ginseng root extract.name: Ginseng Root Extract
panax ginseng root extract.desc: An energizing root extract that helps skin look revived, firmer, and more radiant.

panax ginseng root water.name: Ginseng Root Water
panax ginseng root water.desc: A water-based ginseng extract that hydrates and helps give tired-looking skin a fresh glow.

camellia sinensis leaf extract.name: Green Tea Leaf Extract
camellia sinensis leaf extract.desc: An antioxidant-rich extract that helps defend skin against daily stress and soothes its look.

camellia sinensis leaf water.name: Green Tea Leaf Water
camellia sinensis leaf water.desc: A gentle green tea water that hydrates and helps calm the look of stressed skin.

camellia japonica seed oil.name: Camellia (Tsubaki) Seed Oil
camellia japonica seed oil.desc: A lightweight nourishing oil that softens skin and helps lock in a smooth, supple feel.

galactomyces ferment filtrate.name: Galactomyces Ferment Filtrate
galactomyces ferment filtrate.desc: A yeast ferment that hydrates and helps refine the look of pores, tone, and radiance.

bifida ferment lysate.name: Bifida Ferment Lysate
bifida ferment lysate.desc: A probiotic-derived ferment that helps support a resilient-feeling barrier and a smoother look.

saccharomyces ferment filtrate.name: Saccharomyces Ferment Filtrate
saccharomyces ferment filtrate.desc: A yeast ferment that hydrates and helps skin look more even, soft, and conditioned.

saccharomyces/rice ferment filtrate.name: Saccharomyces / Rice Ferment Filtrate
saccharomyces/rice ferment filtrate.desc: A fermented rice-yeast liquid that hydrates and helps support a brighter, smoother look.

lactobacillus ferment.name: Lactobacillus Ferment
lactobacillus ferment.desc: A probiotic ferment that helps support skin's natural balance for a calm, conditioned feel.

lactobacillus/soybean ferment extract.name: Lactobacillus/Soybean Ferment Extract
lactobacillus/soybean ferment extract.desc: A fermented soybean extract that hydrates and helps skin feel nourished and supple.

glycyrrhiza glabra root extract.name: Licorice Root Extract
glycyrrhiza glabra root extract.desc: A licorice-derived extract that helps brighten the look of dark spots and soothes the skin.

dipotassium glycyrrhizate.name: Dipotassium Glycyrrhizate
dipotassium glycyrrhizate.desc: A licorice-derived soother that helps calm the look of redness and comfort sensitive skin.

polydeoxyribonucleotide.name: PDRN (Salmon DNA)
polydeoxyribonucleotide.desc: A salmon-derived ingredient that helps skin look revitalized, plump, and well-conditioned.

polynucleotides.name: Polynucleotides (PN)
polynucleotides.desc: A nucleotide-based active that helps support a smoother, more supple, revitalized look.

portulaca oleracea extract.name: Purslane Extract
portulaca oleracea extract.desc: A calming plant extract that helps soothe sensitive-looking skin and supports a comfortable feel.

fragrance.name: Fragrance (Parfum)
fragrance.desc: Added scent that makes a product smell pleasant but can bother fragrance-sensitive skin.

copper tripeptide-1.name: Copper Peptide (GHK-Cu)
copper tripeptide-1.desc: A copper-bound peptide that supports the look of firmer, smoother skin and helps maintain a healthy barrier.

palmitoyl tripeptide-1.name: Palmitoyl Tripeptide-1
palmitoyl tripeptide-1.desc: A messenger peptide that supports the appearance of firmness and helps smooth the look of fine lines.

palmitoyl tripeptide-5.name: Palmitoyl Tripeptide-5
palmitoyl tripeptide-5.desc: A peptide that supports a plumper, firmer-looking complexion and helps soften the appearance of lines.

palmitoyl pentapeptide-4.name: Matrixyl (Pal-KTTKS)
palmitoyl pentapeptide-4.desc: A well-known peptide that supports smoother, firmer-looking skin and helps reduce the appearance of fine lines.

palmitoyl tetrapeptide-7.name: Palmitoyl Tetrapeptide-7
palmitoyl tetrapeptide-7.desc: A peptide that helps calm the look of stressed skin and supports a smoother, more even appearance.

acetyl hexapeptide-8.name: Argireline (Acetyl Hexapeptide-8)
acetyl hexapeptide-8.desc: A peptide that helps soften the look of expression lines for a smoother-appearing surface.

acetyl tetrapeptide-5.name: Acetyl Tetrapeptide-5
acetyl tetrapeptide-5.desc: A peptide often used around the eyes that helps the area look less puffy and smoother.

dipeptide diaminobutyroyl benzylamide di.name: SYN-AKE Peptide
dipeptide diaminobutyroyl benzylamide di.desc: A peptide that helps relax the look of fine expression lines for a smoother appearance.

sh-oligopeptide-1.name: EGF (Epidermal Growth Factor)
sh-oligopeptide-1.desc: A lab-made signaling protein included to support the look of refreshed, conditioned, resilient-appearing skin.

sh-polypeptide-1.name: Recombinant Growth Factor Protein
sh-polypeptide-1.desc: A bioengineered protein included to support the appearance of healthy-looking, well-conditioned skin.

hexapeptide-9.name: Hexapeptide-9
hexapeptide-9.desc: A peptide that supports the look of bouncy, firm skin and a smoother surface.

tripeptide-1.name: Tripeptide-1
tripeptide-1.desc: A small peptide that supports the appearance of firmness and overall skin conditioning.

bisabolol.name: Bisabolol (Chamomile-derived)
bisabolol.desc: A chamomile-derived ingredient that helps calm the look of redness and soothe sensitive skin.

ectoin.name: Ectoin
ectoin.desc: A protective hydrator that helps skin retain moisture and stay comfortable against environmental stress.

zinc pca.name: Zinc PCA
zinc pca.desc: A zinc-based ingredient that helps balance the look of oily skin while keeping it hydrated.

colloidal oatmeal.name: Colloidal Oatmeal
colloidal oatmeal.desc: Finely milled oats that help soothe and comfort the feel of dry, easily irritated-looking skin.

avena sativa kernel extract.name: Oat Extract
avena sativa kernel extract.desc: An oat-derived extract that helps calm and soften skin while supporting a comfortable barrier.

hippophae rhamnoides fruit extract.name: Sea Buckthorn Extract
hippophae rhamnoides fruit extract.desc: A vitamin-rich berry extract that helps nourish and soothe skin while supporting a healthy glow.

hippophae rhamnoides oil.name: Sea Buckthorn Oil
hippophae rhamnoides oil.desc: A nourishing orange oil that helps soften skin and support a comfortable, conditioned feel.

chamomilla recutita flower extract.name: Chamomile Extract
chamomilla recutita flower extract.desc: A chamomile extract that helps calm the look of redness and soothe sensitive skin.

calendula officinalis flower extract.name: Calendula Extract
calendula officinalis flower extract.desc: A marigold extract that helps comfort and soften delicate, easily irritated skin.

scutellaria baicalensis root extract.name: Baikal Skullcap Extract
scutellaria baicalensis root extract.desc: A plant root extract that helps soothe skin and support protection against environmental stress.

phenoxyethanol.name: Phenoxyethanol
phenoxyethanol.desc: A widely used preservative that helps keep a product free of bacteria and mold so it stays safe to use over time.

ethylhexylglycerin.name: Ethylhexylglycerin
ethylhexylglycerin.desc: A gentle preservative booster that supports other preservatives while also softening and conditioning the skin.

chlorphenesin.name: Chlorphenesin
chlorphenesin.desc: A preservative that helps protect a product from microbial growth so it keeps fresh through use.

potassium sorbate.name: Potassium Sorbate
potassium sorbate.desc: A mild food-grade preservative that helps stop yeast and mold from growing in a product.

sodium benzoate.name: Sodium Benzoate
sodium benzoate.desc: A gentle preservative that helps keep a formula stable and free from bacteria during its shelf life.

benzyl alcohol.name: Benzyl Alcohol
benzyl alcohol.desc: A naturally occurring preservative and solvent that helps protect a product from spoilage.

benzoic acid.name: Benzoic Acid
benzoic acid.desc: A preservative that helps prevent the growth of mold and bacteria to keep a product safe.

sorbic acid.name: Sorbic Acid
sorbic acid.desc: A gentle preservative that helps protect a formula against yeast and mold.

dehydroacetic acid.name: Dehydroacetic Acid
dehydroacetic acid.desc: A preservative that helps keep a product free of microbes so it stays fresh and safe.

methylparaben.name: Methylparaben
methylparaben.desc: A long-established preservative that helps keep a product free from bacteria and fungus.

propylparaben.name: Propylparaben
propylparaben.desc: A preservative from the paraben family that helps protect a formula from microbial spoilage.

ethylparaben.name: Ethylparaben
ethylparaben.desc: A preservative that helps keep a product stable and safe by limiting bacterial growth.

butylparaben.name: Butylparaben
butylparaben.desc: A preservative that helps guard a formula against bacteria and mold over its shelf life.

imidazolidinyl urea.name: Imidazolidinyl Urea
imidazolidinyl urea.desc: A preservative that helps protect water-based products from bacterial contamination.

diazolidinyl urea.name: Diazolidinyl Urea
diazolidinyl urea.desc: A preservative that helps keep a product free of microbes to maintain freshness.

dmdm hydantoin.name: DMDM Hydantoin
dmdm hydantoin.desc: A preservative that helps prevent bacterial growth so a product stays safe to use.

methylisothiazolinone.name: Methylisothiazolinone
methylisothiazolinone.desc: A potent preservative used in very small amounts, mainly in rinse-off products; a frequent contact allergen now restricted in leave-on products.

methylchloroisothiazolinone.name: Methylchloroisothiazolinone
methylchloroisothiazolinone.desc: A potent preservative (used with methylisothiazolinone) effective at very low levels; restricted to rinse-off products due to allergy risk.

sodium metabisulfite.name: Sodium Metabisulfite
sodium metabisulfite.desc: An antioxidant stabilizer that helps keep sensitive ingredients from breaking down in the bottle.

disodium edta.name: Disodium EDTA
disodium edta.desc: A chelator that grabs onto stray metal ions to help a product stay stable and work better.

tetrasodium edta.name: Tetrasodium EDTA
tetrasodium edta.desc: A chelator that binds trace metals in the water to help keep a formula stable and effective.

trisodium ethylenediamine disuccinate.name: Trisodium Ethylenediamine Disuccinate
trisodium ethylenediamine disuccinate.desc: A biodegradable chelator that ties up metal ions to help support a formula's stability.

sodium phytate.name: Sodium Phytate
sodium phytate.desc: A gentle plant-based chelator that helps keep a formula stable by binding stray metal ions.

sodium hydroxide.name: Sodium Hydroxide
sodium hydroxide.desc: A pH adjuster used in tiny amounts to help balance a formula to a skin-friendly level.

potassium hydroxide.name: Potassium Hydroxide
potassium hydroxide.desc: A pH adjuster that helps bring a formula to the right acidity for comfortable use.

tromethamine.name: Tromethamine
tromethamine.desc: A buffering agent that helps neutralize and stabilize the pH of a gel or lotion.

triethanolamine.name: Triethanolamine
triethanolamine.desc: A pH adjuster that helps balance acidity and supports a smooth, even texture.

aminomethyl propanol.name: Aminomethyl Propanol
aminomethyl propanol.desc: A buffering agent that helps set a formula's pH and supports gel thickeners.

sodium citrate.name: Sodium Citrate
sodium citrate.desc: A buffering salt that helps hold a formula at a steady, skin-friendly pH.

xanthan gum.name: Xanthan Gum
xanthan gum.desc: A natural thickener that helps give a product a smooth, even texture and keeps ingredients evenly mixed.

carbomer.name: Carbomer
carbomer.desc: A gel-forming thickener that helps create a smooth, lightweight texture and stabilizes the formula.

acrylates/c10-30 alkyl acrylate crosspol.name: Acrylates/C10-30 Alkyl Acrylate Crosspolymer
acrylates/c10-30 alkyl acrylate crosspol.desc: A thickening and stabilizing polymer that helps keep oils and water blended into a smooth gel or cream.

sodium polyacrylate.name: Sodium Polyacrylate
sodium polyacrylate.desc: A polymer thickener that helps give a formula body and a silky, even feel.

hydroxyethylcellulose.name: Hydroxyethylcellulose
hydroxyethylcellulose.desc: A plant-derived thickener that helps create a smooth gel texture and keeps ingredients suspended.

cocamidopropyl betaine.name: Cocamidopropyl Betaine
cocamidopropyl betaine.desc: A gentle coconut-derived cleanser that helps create foam and softens the harshness of stronger surfactants.

sodium cocoyl isethionate.name: Sodium Cocoyl Isethionate
sodium cocoyl isethionate.desc: A soft coconut-based cleanser that helps lift away dirt and oil while supporting a creamy, gentle lather.

sodium lauroyl methyl isethionate.name: Sodium Lauroyl Methyl Isethionate
sodium lauroyl methyl isethionate.desc: A very mild cleansing agent that helps cleanse skin gently while keeping a soft, cushiony foam.

coco-glucoside.name: Coco-Glucoside
coco-glucoside.desc: A sugar-and-coconut cleanser that helps remove grime gently and supports skin comfort during washing.

decyl glucoside.name: Decyl Glucoside
decyl glucoside.desc: A plant-sugar cleanser that helps create mild foam and supports gentle cleansing for delicate skin.

lauryl glucoside.name: Lauryl Glucoside
lauryl glucoside.desc: A gentle sugar-derived cleanser that helps loosen oil and dirt while keeping skin feeling soft.

sodium laureth sulfate.name: Sodium Laureth Sulfate (SLES)
sodium laureth sulfate.desc: A widely used foaming cleanser that helps produce rich lather and lift away oil and buildup.

sodium lauryl sulfate.name: Sodium Lauryl Sulfate (SLS)
sodium lauryl sulfate.desc: A strong foaming cleanser that helps remove oil effectively but can feel stripping on sensitive skin.

sodium lauroyl sarcosinate.name: Sodium Lauroyl Sarcosinate
sodium lauroyl sarcosinate.desc: An amino-acid-based cleanser that helps foam gently and supports a smooth after-wash feel.

peg-7 glyceryl cocoate.name: PEG-7 Glyceryl Cocoate
peg-7 glyceryl cocoate.desc: A mild cleansing helper that supports softer foam and helps leave a conditioned feel on skin.

disodium laureth sulfosuccinate.name: Disodium Laureth Sulfosuccinate
disodium laureth sulfosuccinate.desc: A gentle co-surfactant that helps boost foam while softening the feel of stronger cleansers.

polysorbate 20.name: Polysorbate 20
polysorbate 20.desc: A mild solubilizer that helps blend oils and fragrances evenly into water-based formulas.

polysorbate 80.name: Polysorbate 80
polysorbate 80.desc: A versatile solubilizer that helps disperse oils into water and supports stable, clear textures.

sorbitan oleate.name: Sorbitan Oleate (Span 80)
sorbitan oleate.desc: An oil-loving emulsifier that helps keep water and oil mixed together in creams and lotions.

sodium cocoyl glycinate.name: Sodium Cocoyl Glycinate
sodium cocoyl glycinate.desc: A soft amino-acid cleanser that helps foam gently and supports a fresh, non-tight feel after rinsing.

potassium cocoyl glycinate.name: Potassium Cocoyl Glycinate
potassium cocoyl glycinate.desc: A mild amino-acid cleanser that helps create creamy foam while keeping skin feeling comfortable.

sodium cocoyl glutamate.name: Sodium Cocoyl Glutamate
sodium cocoyl glutamate.desc: A gentle amino-acid cleanser that helps wash away impurities while supporting the skin's soft feel.

sodium lauroyl glutamate.name: Sodium Lauroyl Glutamate
sodium lauroyl glutamate.desc: A mild amino-acid cleanser that helps produce fine foam and keeps skin feeling balanced.

disodium cocoyl glutamate.name: Disodium Cocoyl Glutamate
disodium cocoyl glutamate.desc: A soft co-cleanser that helps round out foam while supporting gentle, comfortable washing.

sodium methyl cocoyl taurate.name: Sodium Methyl Cocoyl Taurate
sodium methyl cocoyl taurate.desc: A taurine-based cleanser that helps build dense, cushiony foam and supports a soft after-feel.

sodium cocoamphoacetate.name: Sodium Cocoamphoacetate
sodium cocoamphoacetate.desc: A mild coconut-derived cleanser that helps foam gently and softens stronger surfactants.

disodium cocoamphodiacetate.name: Disodium Cocoamphodiacetate
disodium cocoamphodiacetate.desc: A very gentle cleanser often used in baby and sensitive formulas to help cleanse without harshness.

lauramidopropyl betaine.name: Lauramidopropyl Betaine
lauramidopropyl betaine.desc: A mild foam-boosting cleanser that helps soften formulas and supports gentle washing.

cocamidopropyl hydroxysultaine.name: Cocamidopropyl Hydroxysultaine
cocamidopropyl hydroxysultaine.desc: A gentle cleanser that helps create stable foam and supports mildness even in hard water.

caprylyl/capryl glucoside.name: Caprylyl/Capryl Glucoside
caprylyl/capryl glucoside.desc: A light sugar-derived cleanser that helps remove oil gently while supporting a soft skin feel.

sodium c14-16 olefin sulfonate.name: Sodium C14-16 Olefin Sulfonate
sodium c14-16 olefin sulfonate.desc: A foaming cleanser that helps produce strong lather and lift away oil and surface buildup.

cocamide mea.name: Cocamide MEA
cocamide mea.desc: A coconut-derived helper that supports thicker foam and a richer feel in cleansers.

cocamide dea.name: Cocamide DEA
cocamide dea.desc: A foam-stabilizing and thickening helper that supports a creamier lather in wash-off products.

lauryl betaine.name: Lauryl Betaine
lauryl betaine.desc: A mild cleanser that helps foam gently and supports the softness of surfactant blends.

peg-40 hydrogenated castor oil.name: PEG-40 Hydrogenated Castor Oil
peg-40 hydrogenated castor oil.desc: A solubilizer that helps dissolve fragrances and oils into clear water-based formulas.

peg-80 sorbitan laurate.name: PEG-80 Sorbitan Laurate
peg-80 sorbitan laurate.desc: A very mild cleanser used in tear-free formulas that helps cleanse gently with light foam.

coco-betaine.name: Coco-Betaine
coco-betaine.desc: A coconut-derived cleanser that helps build foam and softens the feel of stronger surfactants.

sodium myreth sulfate.name: Sodium Myreth Sulfate
sodium myreth sulfate.desc: A foaming cleanser that helps create lather and lift away oil and everyday buildup.

polyglyceryl-10 laurate.name: Polyglyceryl-10 Laurate
polyglyceryl-10 laurate.desc: A plant-based gentle cleanser and emulsifier that helps blend oils and supports mild cleansing.

sodium cocoyl taurate.name: Sodium Cocoyl Taurate
sodium cocoyl taurate.desc: A taurine-derived cleanser that helps create silky foam and supports a gentle after-feel.

zinc oxide.name: Zinc Oxide
zinc oxide.desc: A mineral filter that sits on skin and helps shield it from a broad range of UV rays while gently soothing.

titanium dioxide.name: Titanium Dioxide
titanium dioxide.desc: A mineral filter that reflects and scatters UV light to help protect skin from sun exposure.

ethylhexyl methoxycinnamate.name: Octinoxate
ethylhexyl methoxycinnamate.desc: A widely used filter that helps absorb UVB rays to support the skin's defense against sunburn.

octocrylene.name: Octocrylene
octocrylene.desc: A filter that helps absorb UV light and supports the stability of other sunscreen ingredients.

ethylhexyl salicylate.name: Octisalate
ethylhexyl salicylate.desc: A gentle filter that helps absorb UVB rays and supports a smooth, water-resistant sunscreen feel.

homosalate.name: Homosalate
homosalate.desc: An oil-soluble filter that helps absorb UVB rays to support protection from sunburn.

butyl methoxydibenzoylmethane.name: Avobenzone
butyl methoxydibenzoylmethane.desc: A key filter that helps absorb UVA rays to support protection against sun-related aging.

bis-ethylhexyloxyphenol methoxyphenyl tr.name: Tinosorb S
bis-ethylhexyloxyphenol methoxyphenyl tr.desc: A modern broad-spectrum filter that helps absorb both UVA and UVB rays for stable sun protection.

methylene bis-benzotriazolyl tetramethyl.name: Tinosorb M
methylene bis-benzotriazolyl tetramethyl.desc: A hybrid filter that both absorbs and scatters UV light to support broad-spectrum sun protection.

diethylamino hydroxybenzoyl hexyl benzoa.name: Uvinul A Plus
diethylamino hydroxybenzoyl hexyl benzoa.desc: A photostable filter that helps absorb UVA rays to support defense against sun-induced aging.

ethylhexyl triazone.name: Uvinul T 150
ethylhexyl triazone.desc: A highly efficient UVB filter that helps absorb sunburn-causing rays at low concentrations.

diethylhexyl butamido triazone.name: Uvasorb HEB
diethylhexyl butamido triazone.desc: A photostable UVB filter that helps absorb sunburn rays to support all-day protection.

drometrizole trisiloxane.name: Mexoryl XL
drometrizole trisiloxane.desc: A photostable filter that helps absorb both UVA and UVB rays for lasting protection.

terephthalylidene dicamphor sulfonic aci.name: Mexoryl SX
terephthalylidene dicamphor sulfonic aci.desc: A water-soluble filter that helps absorb shorter UVA rays to support defense against sun damage.

phenylbenzimidazole sulfonic acid.name: Ensulizole
phenylbenzimidazole sulfonic acid.desc: A water-soluble UVB filter that helps absorb sunburn rays while keeping textures light.

benzophenone-3.name: Oxybenzone
benzophenone-3.desc: A chemical filter that helps absorb UV light to support broad protection against sun exposure; can sensitize some skin and is restricted in some markets.

parfum.name: Parfum
parfum.desc: The European labeling term for added scent, a common source of sensitivity for reactive skin.

limonene.name: Limonene
limonene.desc: A citrus-smelling fragrance component that adds scent but is a recognized allergen for some people.

linalool.name: Linalool
linalool.desc: A floral fragrance component that adds scent and is a known allergen for sensitive skin.

citronellol.name: Citronellol
citronellol.desc: A rose-like fragrance component that adds scent but is a listed allergen for some users.

geraniol.name: Geraniol
geraniol.desc: A sweet, floral fragrance component that adds scent and is a recognized skin allergen.

citral.name: Citral
citral.desc: A lemony fragrance component that adds scent but is a known allergen for reactive skin.

eugenol.name: Eugenol
eugenol.desc: A clove-like fragrance component that adds scent and is a listed allergen for some people.

coumarin.name: Coumarin
coumarin.desc: A sweet, hay-like fragrance component that adds scent and is a recognized skin allergen.

benzyl salicylate.name: Benzyl Salicylate
benzyl salicylate.desc: A soft floral fragrance component that adds scent and is a recognized allergen for some users.

hexyl cinnamal.name: Hexyl Cinnamal
hexyl cinnamal.desc: A jasmine-like fragrance component that adds scent but is a listed skin allergen.

hydroxycitronellal.name: Hydroxycitronellal
hydroxycitronellal.desc: A delicate floral fragrance component that adds scent and is a recognized allergen.

alpha-isomethyl ionone.name: Alpha-Isomethyl Ionone
alpha-isomethyl ionone.desc: A violet-like fragrance component that adds scent and is a listed skin allergen.

butylphenyl methylpropional.name: Lilial
butylphenyl methylpropional.desc: A floral fragrance component that adds scent and is a recognized allergen for sensitive skin.

alcohol denat..name: Denatured Alcohol
alcohol denat..desc: A fast-evaporating alcohol that helps products feel light but can be drying with frequent use.

alcohol.name: Ethanol
alcohol.desc: A simple alcohol that helps thin formulas and speed drying but can dry out skin over time.

sd alcohol 40-b.name: SD Alcohol 40-B
sd alcohol 40-b.desc: A specially denatured alcohol that helps products feel weightless but can be drying for some skin.

menthol.name: Menthol
menthol.desc: A mint-derived ingredient that gives a cooling tingle but can irritate sensitive or compromised skin.

lavandula angustifolia oil.name: Lavender Oil
lavandula angustifolia oil.desc: A lavender essential oil that adds natural scent and aroma but can sensitize reactive skin.

citrus limon peel oil.name: Lemon Peel Oil
citrus limon peel oil.desc: A citrus essential oil that adds bright scent but can make skin more sensitive to sunlight.

melaleuca alternifolia leaf oil.name: Tea Tree Oil
melaleuca alternifolia leaf oil.desc: A tea-tree essential oil added for its aroma; it can irritate or sensitize skin.

eucalyptus globulus leaf oil.name: Eucalyptus Oil
eucalyptus globulus leaf oil.desc: An aromatic essential oil that adds a fresh, cooling scent but can be irritating for reactive skin.

water.name: Water
water.desc: The base most products are built on; carries and dissolves other ingredients.

aqua.name: Water (Aqua)
aqua.desc: The base most products are built on; carries and dissolves other ingredients.
